items.title: Food handler health checks are carried out and recorded as the specific law requires
items.evidence_hint: occupational health exam records (ASO, PCMSO); handler health control records

items.title: Handlers with lesions or symptoms that may affect food safety stay off food prep while they last
items.evidence_hint: POP for handler hygiene and health; sick leave or exclusion records; Manual de Boas Práticas

items.title: Hands are washed on arrival, before/after handling food, after breaks, toilet or soiling, as needed
items.evidence_hint: POP for handler hygiene and health; handwashing posters; training records

items.title: Prep areas have enough hand-only sinks with antiseptic liquid soap, safe drying and hands-free bins
items.evidence_hint: Manual de Boas Práticas (premises description); hygiene supply checklists

items.title: Handlers wear clean uniforms, changed at least daily and worn only on the premises
items.evidence_hint: Manual de Boas Práticas; POP for handler hygiene and health; uniform change records

items.title: Handlers keep hair tied and covered, no beard, short unpolished nails, and no adornments or makeup
items.evidence_hint: Manual de Boas Práticas; POP for handler hygiene and health; hygiene checklists

items.title: A handler hygiene and health POP covers handwashing, illness, medical exams and training
items.evidence_hint: POP for handler hygiene and health

items.title: All parts of food reach 70°C, or a lower but safe time-temperature, checked by time and temperature
items.evidence_hint: cooking temperature logs; Manual de Boas Práticas or POP for cooking

items.title: Food is thawed below 5°C, or by microwave if cooked at once, then chilled until used, never refrozen
items.evidence_hint: thawing procedure in the Manual de Boas Práticas; refrigerator temperature logs

items.title: Hot-held food is kept above 60°C for no more than 6 hours
items.evidence_hint: hot holding or bain-marie temperature logs; Manual de Boas Práticas

items.title: Cooked food is cooled from 60°C to 10°C within two hours
items.evidence_hint: cooling logs with times and temperatures; Manual de Boas Práticas or POP for cooling

items.title: Cooled prepared food is kept below 5°C or frozen at -18°C or lower
items.evidence_hint: refrigerator and freezer temperature logs; POP for cold storage

items.title: Refrigerated and frozen storage temperatures are monitored regularly and recorded
items.evidence_hint: refrigerator and freezer temperature logs

items.title: Prepared food chilled at 4°C or less is consumed within 5 days, and sooner when kept above 4°C
items.evidence_hint: shelf-life rules in the Manual de Boas Práticas; labels; refrigerator temperature logs

items.title: Opened ingredients and stored prepared food are labelled with name, date and use-by date
items.evidence_hint: labelling procedure in the Manual de Boas Práticas; label templates; storage checklists

items.title: Deliveries are inspected; chilled or frozen goods are temperature-checked on receipt and in storage
items.evidence_hint: receiving logs with temperatures; storage temperature logs; receiving procedure in the Manual de Boas Práticas

items.title: Frying oil is kept at 180°C or less and replaced at once if its smell, taste or look clearly changes
items.evidence_hint: frying oil change records; frying procedure in the Manual de Boas Práticas

items.title: Raw, semi-prepared and ready-to-eat foods are kept from direct or indirect contact
items.evidence_hint: Manual de Boas Práticas; storage layout; colour-coded board and utensil rules

items.title: Staff handling raw food wash and sanitize their hands before touching prepared food
items.evidence_hint: POP for handler hygiene and health; Manual de Boas Práticas; training records

items.title: Where applicable, food eaten raw is sanitized with approved products, leaving no residue
items.evidence_hint: produce sanitizing procedure with product, concentration and contact time; sanitizer registration

items.title: Servers sanitize their hands and handle prepared food with utensils or disposable gloves
items.evidence_hint: service and display procedure in the Manual de Boas Práticas; training records

items.title: Rejected or expired goods are returned at once or else labelled, kept apart and given a destination
items.evidence_hint: receiving logs; return or non-conformity records

items.title: Premises, equipment and utensils stay sanitized, prep areas as often as needed and right after work
items.evidence_hint: cleaning plan or schedule; cleaning checklists

items.title: Non-routine cleaning and disinfection of premises and equipment is recorded
items.evidence_hint: deep-cleaning records; cleaning logs

items.title: Cleaning products are registered, used per label dilution and contact time, and stored apart
items.evidence_hint: cleaning product list with registration numbers; POP for cleaning; dilution instructions

items.title: A cleaning POP states surface, method, active agent, concentration, contact time and temperature
items.evidence_hint: POP for cleaning premises, equipment and furniture

items.title: Premises and equipment are free of pests under continuous preventive control
items.evidence_hint: pest control service reports; pest sighting records; POP for pest control

items.title: Chemical pest control is done by a specialized company, with proof of each service on file
items.evidence_hint: pest control service certificates (comprovante de execução); contractor licence

items.title: A pest control POP describes the preventive and corrective measures
items.evidence_hint: POP for integrated pest control

items.title: External openings of food areas have removable insect screens and doors close automatically
items.evidence_hint: Manual de Boas Práticas (premises); maintenance records; pest control reports

items.title: Only potable water is used; an alternative supply has lab potability reports every six months
items.evidence_hint: water supply description in the Manual de Boas Práticas; laboratory potability reports

items.title: Ice and steam that touch food are made from potable water
items.evidence_hint: water control section of the Manual de Boas Práticas; ice supplier or ice machine records

items.title: The covered, sound water tank is cleaned and disinfected at least every six months, with records
items.evidence_hint: water tank cleaning certificates or records with dates

items.title: A water tank cleaning POP exists, with a service certificate when the cleaning is outsourced
items.evidence_hint: POP for water tank cleaning; service certificate

items.title: Floors, walls and ceilings are smooth, impermeable and washable, and free of cracks, leaks and mould
items.evidence_hint: maintenance records; Manual de Boas Práticas (premises); self-inspection checklists

items.title: Equipment gets scheduled maintenance and measuring instruments are calibrated, with records
items.evidence_hint: maintenance plan and records; thermometer calibration certificates

items.title: Waste bins are identified and sufficient, with hands-free lids in food areas
items.evidence_hint: waste handling section of the Manual de Boas Práticas

items.title: Waste is collected often and stored in a closed area isolated from food areas
items.evidence_hint: waste handling section of the Manual de Boas Práticas; collection schedule or contractor records

items.title: A Good Practices Manual covering the required topics and POPs are available to staff
items.evidence_hint: Manual de Boas Práticas; list of POPs

items.title: POPs give steps, frequency and responsible staff, and are approved, dated and signed
items.evidence_hint: POPs (approval, date and signature block)

items.title: Records are dated, name who filled them in and are kept for at least 30 days
items.evidence_hint: temperature, cleaning and receiving logs

items.title: Handlers are supervised and trained periodically in hygiene and foodborne disease, with records
items.evidence_hint: training records with attendee names, hours and content; training programme

items.title: The person in charge of food handling has taken a course on the required good-practice topics
items.evidence_hint: course certificate of the person in charge; designation in the Manual de Boas Práticas

items.title: Written criteria exist for evaluating and selecting suppliers of ingredients and packaging
items.evidence_hint: supplier selection criteria or approved supplier list; Manual de Boas Práticas
